host.ask: Address of the microscope PC (SharkSEM listens there)
host.help: The TESCAN control PC; SharkSEM remote control must be enabled and licensed in the microscope software. Use 127.0.0.1 if this package runs on that PC.

port.help: 8300 is the port public example scripts use (unverified); the SharkSEM manual and the microscope software's remote-control settings give the real one.

image_dir.ask: Folder the acquired TIFFs are written to

reference_width_mm.ask: Reference width in mm that TESCAN's magnification is defined against (the manual's display width; 120 is a placeholder)

pump_timeout_s.ask: Seconds to wait for a pump or vent before the job is failed

sharksem.ask: SharkSEM client module and function names (JSON object), from the SharkSEM manual
sharksem.help: Every shipped name is a placeholder; correct them from TESCAN's SharkSEM manual before the first hardware test.
